name: Defensive Wrestling (Combat)
body:
You have trained to defend yourself from many close range attacks.

Prerequisite(s): (Improved Unarmed Strike or Weapon Focus in a melee weapon from the close fighter weapon group), (base attack bonus +5 or Monk level 5th).

Benefit(s): If you possess the Improved Unarmed Strike feat or are wielding a melee weapon from the close fighter weapon group you have selected with Weapon Focus you may make an attack of opportunity when targeted by a bull rush, grapple, or overrun combat maneuver. This attack of opportunity may be made even if the attacker possesses a feat or special ability that otherwise would allow them to ignore attacks of opportunity with those combat maneuvers. If your attack hits and deals damage, you add the total damage dealt to your CMD against that opponent until the end of their turn.
